name: Fishtro
description: Future Crew's invitation intro for Assembly '92
author: Future Crew
contentNote: Contains nudity: its exit picture shows the party's mascot, Melvin, drawn bare-breasted.

ready.stdout: Press ESC to change the configuration

start.note: DosKit takes its setup's defaults, a 486 and a Sound Blaster at 220h, IRQ 7. It shows a notice of this version's first distributor for about 3 seconds before the intro.

hint: Fishtro waits at its setup: press Enter to start it with its defaults, a 486 and a Sound Blaster.
